prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background tile for a vertically scrolling Touhou-inspired bullet-hell game, portrait 2:3 composition. Create exquisite hand-crafted 16-bit Japanese pixel scenery, deliberate clean pixel clusters, restrained 24-color palette, no anti-aliased painting, no 3D rendering, no text, no UI, no people, no projectiles. Orthographic top-down view, no horizon or perspective vanishing point. Seamless vertical repetition: top and bottom must meet with the same architectural/mottled surface pattern. The middle 65 percent is dark, calm negative space for readable bullets; richer detail hugs the far side edges. Deep navy values, never bright white. Professional GBA/late SNES quality, detailed rather than crude block outlines. No frame, no montage. Alice's moonlit doll workshop viewed from above: a long midnight-blue runner over warm walnut floorboards, slender brass seam inlays, indigo velvet and faded red ribbons at outer edges, tiny thread spools and wooden doll-making tools arranged naturally along the side workbenches. Muted amber lamps and pale cyan window-light puddles along the margins, repeated carved wooden structures, cozy mysterious atmosphere. Keep central runner free of obstacles and decoration.
